page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 24 dedicated physical cores with a clock speed of 3.1 GHz and a 1:1 vCPU-to-physical-core ratio. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates on a KVM hypervisor with an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. In CPU-intensive tasks, it achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1438.39 and a multi-core score of 23015.19, alongside a Geekbench multi-core score of 9875.0. Its memory subsystem delivers a read-only large block bandwidth of 109.43 GB/sec and a write large block bandwidth of 48.03 GB/sec. For specialized tasks, the instance processes Redis SET operations at 22.14 million operations per second and handles static web serving throughput at 17.13 GB/sec. Small-model LLM inference runs at 78.25 tokens per second for text generation, while medium-model inference drops to 12.72 tokens per second.

The absence of local storage means all storage operations must rely on network-attached volumes, which may impact I/O-heavy workloads. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides dedicated physical cores without the overhead of simultaneous multithreading, offering predictable compute resources per unit of spend for workloads that do not require local NVMe storage. It is appropriate for applications such as web serving, Redis caching, software compilation, and moderate database operations.
